title: "2-25Class"
format: html

```{r}
library(mlbench)
library(ggplot2)
data(BostonHousing2)

```

```{r}
ggplot(BostonHousing2, aes(x = medv, y = chas)) +
  geom_boxplot(median.color = "red", color= "blue") + theme_classic()+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(color= "red")
  )+
  labs(x= "Median Value of Owner-Occupied Homes in USD 1000's",
       y= "Charles River Dummy Variable")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,50, by= 5))
  
```
